t: Designed for silent showering. Takes cold water on low pressure, gravity fed systems and silently delivers a strong and consistent performance due to brushless motor. Pump cannot be heard when water is running. The same footprint and screwholes as the Elite QT and ST makes it an easy replacement. Clean-flo filter. Self-service inlet filter (no call-out required). Dual outlet combines the experience of a deluge overhead and a separate handshower.
b: Suitable for Cold Water Gravity-Fed Supply Only
